headline: Senior Systems & Data Architect
summary: Senior systems and data architect with 12+ years building reliable batch and streaming platforms. Проектирую отказоустойчивые конвейеры данных на Python, SQL, Spark и Airflow.

bullets: Designed and operated batch and streaming data pipelines on Spark and Airflow.
Built Python ingestion services and tuned SQL workloads for analytics teams.
Containerized pipeline jobs with Docker and standardized deployment.
Architected a multi-tenant data platform with Python and SQL.
Introduced Airflow orchestration and Spark-based processing.

ai_bullets: Automated resume tailoring with a deterministic Python toolbelt.
Added a sanitizer that strips prompt-injection attempts from vacancy text.

projects.name: Streaming Analytics Pipeline
bullets: Delivered a Spark and Airflow pipeline processing retail events.
Packaged services with Docker for reproducible deployments.
